title: Melange: A Synthetic Visual Bias Benchmark for Multi-modal Large Language Models

problem.summary: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have seen broad adoption, but their biases are still far less examined than those of standard LLMs, creating possible social harms when deployed in real-world settings.
statements: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have seen broad adoption, but their biases are still far less examined than those of standard LLMs, creating possible social harms when deployed in real-world settings.

Prior efforts to extend bias analyses from LLMs into the multi-modal space either cover only a few bias categories or do not ensure that the groups being compared are clearly addressed by visual cues in the images.
To overcome these limitations, we introduce Melange, a wide-ranging synthetic visual benchmark covering seven categories for assessing social biases in MLLMs.

limitations.summary: By evaluating the same BBQ-derived scenarios in matched text-only and vision-only settings, we isolate the fairness effect of the input modality.
items: By evaluating the same BBQ-derived scenarios in matched text-only and vision-only settings, we isolate the fairness effect of the input modality.
A perception control confirms that this gap is not an artifact of visual comprehension: models identify the depicted demographic attributes at 90-95% accuracy yet still fail to abstain.
Our study has several limitations that should be considered when interpreting the results.
